How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture for selling Notion templates operates on a combination of free and paid tools that facilitate an efficient and secure commerce experience. With the COREMERCH Complete Builder Kit, you'll utilize platforms like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, ensuring that your content is instantly accessible. At the same time, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script serve as the engine behind your transaction logic, providing robust backend capabilities. The automatic crypto payment processing is handled through NOWPayments, ensuring that you can verify transactions effortlessly. This stack not only minimizes costs but maximizes your control over your digital products.

The Components That Make It Work Together

The successful deployment of your Notion template commerce stack hinges on several key components. First, GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages host your digital storefront, providing a solid and free foundation for serving your content. Next, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle the backend logic, allowing for dynamic interactions and automation. Order management can be efficiently managed via Supabase or Google Sheets—keeping your inventory organized. Lastly, NOWPayments facilitates cryptocurrency transactions, automatically converting your prices to crypto at the moment of sale. Each of these components is carefully selected to work harmoniously, ensuring a smooth and efficient experience for both you and your customers.

Integrate NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions, ensuring that you can accept payments in your preferred digital currencies. After setting everything up, test your system thoroughly to ensure smooth delivery and payment processing.
